answers.q1: Go modules with make (Makefile wraps go). Install dependencies with: make install_deps (which runs `go get -v ./...`). Plain `go mod download` also works.
answers.q2: make test (runs install_deps, then `go test -v ./...`). Direct equivalent: go test -v ./...
answers.q3: go test -v ./doc/ -run 'TestGenMdDoc|TestGenMdDocWithNoLongOrSynopsis|TestGenMdNoHiddenParents|TestGenMdNoTag|TestGenMdTree'. Go can't select tests by file, so this lists the five Test functions in doc/md_docs_test.go. Any helpers or other tests in that file are not named in this pattern. A looser pattern is `go test -v ./doc/ -run 'TestGenMd'`.
answers.q4: CI runs golangci-lint (golangci-lint-action v8, version latest, args --verbose, config .golangci.yml, which enables gofmt and goimports as formatters): `golangci-lint run --verbose`. Locally the Makefile has `make lint` (`golangci-lint run -v`) and `make fmt` (gofmt check). CI also runs a license header check: `docker run -v $(pwd):/wrk -w /wrk ghcr.io/google/addlicense -c 'The Cobra Authors' -y '2013-2023' -l apache -ignore '.github/**' -check .`
answers.q5: None found. There is no vendor/ directory, and I saw no generated source files in the repo root listing. go.sum is tool-managed, so change it with `go mod tidy` rather than by hand. The Makefile's ./bin output directory is a build artifact created by the Makefile, and `make clean` removes it. The files under site/content are hand-written docs, not generated.
